summary: SK hynix Inc. filed a Form 6-K to clarify a media report from Korea Economic Daily on August 5, 2026, alleging that its U.S. subsidiary Solidigm is pursuing a pre-IPO capital raise of approximately KRW 5 trillion. The company confirms that Solidigm is reviewing measures to strengthen competitiveness but states no matters have been determined as of the filing date. It will disclose further details when confirmed or within three months. This is a rumor-clarification disclosure with no definitive transaction announced, so it does not constitute a special situation. What to watch: any definitive capital-raising or potential IPO plans by Solidigm.
